faqs.a:
The resolution under the provisional order method may provide for one or more types
               of construction, and the engineer shall separately estimate the cost of each type
               of construction. The estimate may be made in a lump sum or by unit prices, as to such
               engineer may seem most desirable for the facilities complete in place.
(Code 1981, § 27-11; Ord. No. 551, § 8(B), 5-14-1964)
